record.title: microduck-top-head-shell — Pollen Robotics' published mesh `top_head_shell`, mesh-backed part
record.origin_why: the geometry is the vendor's own published sim asset, loaded unchanged (cecad.meshshelve, 2026-09-01). Not our design; usable to assemble, render, simulate and print; NOT licensed for sale (NC).
record.why: a loader: the mesh is the vendor's; whether it builds as a closed solid is read off bin/cad part:microduck-top-head-shell. MEASURED ABOUT THE MEASUREMENT ITSELF, 2026-09-03 (lane T): that command is not cheap on a shared machine. `ce-cad/bin/cad tools/build_mesh_loaders.py` — which runs this folder's own build() through cecad.triad.load and reports solids, shells, closedness, volume and bbox off the BUILT object — was started here at 22:57 on 2026-09-02 against fourteen mesh-backed folders and had consumed 131 minutes of CPU over 3 h 43 min of wall clock WITHOUT completing, on a Mac whose 1-minute load average ran 41-80 from other lanes' concurrent FreeCAD jobs. Part.from_mesh sewing a 20 000-triangle decimated mesh is the cost. So this folder's verdict is still CANNOT DETERMINE and the reason is now specific: the check has not been run to completion, not that nobody thought to run it. WHAT SETTLES IT: `ce-cad/bin/cad tools/build_mesh_loaders.py microduck-top-head-shell` on an idle machine, one slug at a time; the tool writes out/laneT/build-report.json and exits 1 if any folder produced neither a solid nor a shell. 2026-09-03 (lane A, tools/head_frontfit.py): FAIL against the product photographs on ONE measured feature. In the true front view the accent trim band at the head's split line is 0.9666 ± 0.0090 of the head's own widest row on the product and 1.0000 of it on this mesh set — −3.069 ± 0.831 mm at the mesh width, 3.7σ, and still FAIL under the reading in which only the jaw is accent-coloured (−2.601 mm). On the product this shell overhangs the band by about 1.53 mm per side (confirmed at 8× on both edges, out/head/front_edges.png); on the mesh top_head_shell 91.760, bottom_head_shell 91.763 and jaw 91.416 mm are flush to 0.35 mm. The head's overall WIDTH is 89.386 ± 1.815 mm against this mesh's 91.763 — CANNOT DETERMINE at the 1.5 mm rule, so the shell is NOT rescaled: where a width change comes out of the section is not measurable from photographs, and a lateral scale would move part:microduck-jaw's mouth_horn 1.26 mm off the XL330 horn that does not scale. What settles it: a calliper across one product head.
